description: This file defines a generic internal structure 'DefaultConcurrentObjectPoolPolicy<T>' implementing 'IPooledObjectPolicy<T>' for object pooling in Orleans.Serialization.Invocation. It provides methods to create new instances and manage return behavior for pooled objects.

classes.name: DefaultConcurrentObjectPoolPolicy<T>
classes.description: A generic internal struct providing object pooling policies for Orleans.Serialization.Invocation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of type T.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Indicates whether the object should be returned to the pool; always returns true.
